name: Yasutora Sado (Chad)
note: No build guide available on hideoutgacha.com at time of authoring. Tier/role/damage type sourced from the tier list.

skills.description: Chad throws a flurry of Iron Fists forward that are designed to protect companions, striking 5 times and dealing damage equal to 361.5% of ATK. Each strike grants Spiritual Pressure on hit. At Max Spiritual Pressure, press and hold basic attack to have Chad dash forward, dealing damage over time up to 247.5% of ATK to enemies in his path. He continuously loses HP while dashing, up to 33% of his current HP. When Chad's HP drops below 25% of Max HP, dashing no longer consumes HP. When the hit limit is reached or the basic attack button is released early, Chad instantly releases a powerful attack which deals DMG equalt o 310.37% of ATK.
skills.name: Iron Fist Barrage

skills.description: Chad performs his signature shoulder throw and slams the enemy in front of him to the ground, dealing damage equal to 91.5% of ATK. He then tosses them with tremendous force, dealing damage equal to 136.5% of ATK. after that, immediately tap the absic attack button to release an impaling strike on the enemy in front, dealing damage equal to 148.5% of ATK and accumulating a large amount amount of Spiritual Pressure.
skills.name: Heavy Toss

skills.description: Chad channels his Spiritual Power into Brazo Derecho Del Gigante and unleashes a massive azure Spiritual Pressure shockwave, dealing damage equal to 481.5% of ATK to the enemy hit and immediately restoring HP equal to 30% of Max HP.
skills.name: Transformed Right Arm

skills.description: After blocking an enemy attack with his left fist, Chad channels his Spiritual Power into his right arm and launches a powerful strike forward, dealing damage equal to 802.5% of ATK to the enemy hit.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Dodge to avoid attacks right before they hit. Chad can trigger a Perfect Dodge by dodging into an enemy. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Dodge
